title: Webhook retry queue rollout and staging verification
goal: Introduce a retry queue and dead-letter handling to reduce lost payment webhooks, and before cutover confirm from logs that reprocessing produces the right result in the real order flow.
doneWhen: The payment webhook retry queue is deployed to staging and passes live-call verification.

items.label: Plan · approval
items.title: Plan and approval
items.body: The target is staging and the exit condition is live-call verification after the retry queue deploys. It was approved after one design review and two code reviews.

evidence.text: prod is separate work after the queue

items.label: S1 queue deploy
items.title: S1 retry queue deployed to staging and verified
items.body: Implemented the retry queue, worker, exponential backoff, and dead-letter handling, recording results in logs only alongside the direct call path. All 14 staging live calls passed.

items.label: S1 close
items.title: S1 closed
items.body: Reported the result on SHOP-128, transitioned it to STAGING done, and closed three sub-tasks. The deploy evidence bundle check also passed.

items.label: S2 pre-deploy verify
items.title: S2 duplicate payment prevention: pre-deploy verification
items.body: /verify PASS and a performance review APPROVE. Addressing security (payment key masking hardening) and test review comments; when that is done, deploy to staging and verify the order payment flow with live calls.

evidence.text: Regression runner idempotencyKey support · 78 tests passed

items.label: S2 staging verify
items.title: S2 deploy and staging verification
items.body: Verify in this order: sign in with the test account, complete an order payment, resend the webhook. If no reproducible order exists, report it as blocked.

items.label: Completion audit
items.title: Completion audit
items.body: Compare the S1–S4 artifacts and evidence to decide whether the task can close.

items.label: S3 measurement tooling
items.title: S3 measurement tooling migration and reprocessing-latency remeasurement
items.body: Measurement is done. Batch processing (b) was adopted for S4 at 100% on all three runs of 25 rows (single-row processing 69%). One duplicate webhook flipped 43.5% of the idempotency verdicts, recorded as a risk signal for cutover.

compare.caption: Idempotency verdicts flipped by one duplicate webhook

items.label: S4 idempotency
items.title: S4 duplicate webhook idempotency
items.body: Implement, deploy, and verify using the batch-processing configuration adopted in the S3 remeasurement.

changes.title: Reprocessing order fixed to batch processing (b)
changes.body: 100% across all three runs of 25 rows, higher than single-row processing (69%), so the S4 implementation baseline was changed to batch processing.
